messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: private-vpc-nyc - GPU queue growth detected for pool "cust-nyc-gpu-pool". queue_length=420, provision_failures=12. Paging emma (oncall).

emma: Ack, I'm on it. Pulling logs and metrics now.

raj: I'll start with autoscaler logs and provider API traces.

laura: Heads up - this customer uses our internal registry in their VPC. Last token rotate was at 03:55 UTC.

mike: Any customer impact yet?

nina: Yes, customer reports increased latencies and intermittent 503s for realtime inference. Support ticket CS-1893 opened. They're seeing requests timeout at 60s.

emma: Timeline so far: spike started ~04:15 UTC after a sudden batch job burst. Autoscaler attempted node launches but saw repeated provider errors and timeouts.

raj: Autoscaler snippets:
```
E[04:17:03] launch node failed: provider error: InsufficientCapacity
E[04:18:21] launch retry 3/5
W[04:20:00] pool stuck: pending instances=38, desired=56
```

laura: Also seeing new nodes stuck in ImagePullBackOff; registry auth token shows expired at 03:55 per artifact-service.

mike: So nodes boot but kubelet can't pull images -> pods remain Pending -> autoscaler keeps requesting more nodes -> queue keeps growing.

emma: Mitigation options on the table:
- A) allow temporary fallback registry (public) to pull images
- B) increase node pool max to 80 (provider might reject)
- C) switch to spot/preemptible for short term (higher churn)
- D) throttle customer traffic with an emergency concurrency cap

nina: Customer prefers non-invasive mitigations but agrees to a temporary concurrency cap if needed.

raj: I tried bumping maxNodes to 80; provider returned InsufficientCapacity. Also observed ENI rate limit ThrottlingException when requesting network interfaces.

deploy-bot: deploys/12345 started: hotfix-token-rotate -> artifact-service (triggered by raj).

laura: I'll rotate the registry token immediately. ETA ~6m for artifact-service rollout.

emma: Please rotate and keep us posted. Also let's plan to shift some traffic to a smaller model variant to reduce per-request GPU memory and lower queue pressure.

laura: Registry token rotated and rollout in progress. Rolling restart to pick up new token started.

raj: Checking nodes again: new nodes are booting and kubelet now progressing. Pods transitioning from ContainerCreating -> Running. Backlog starting to drain.

mike: Queue trending down but still ~180 in-flight; old queued requests will still time out if exceed 60s.

nina: Notified customer (CS-1893) with interim status: token rotated, capacity draining. Customer asked for ETA on full recovery.

emma: Estimate ~10-15 minutes for backlog to clear at current drain rate. I'm going to apply a temporary rate-limit to this customer's routes to avoid a relapse.

emma: Applied rate-limit: /cust/nyc/* -> 10rps. This should reduce incoming pressure and let the system catch up.

raj: Autoscaler now shows some successful launches but a couple of new nodes were preempted (spot). Switching new launches to on-demand for stability.

laura: Adjusted pod priorities: realtime inference pods set to high priority; batch jobs set to low so they get evicted ahead of realtime.

deploy-bot: rollout complete: artifact-service v2.4.1 - registry token refreshed and new nodes able to pull images.

mike: Metrics: queue < 50, avg latency for new requests dropped from 820ms -> 220ms. Throughput recovering.

nina: Customer confirms 503s reduced. They still have logs showing timeouts between 04:25-04:28 for requests queued >60s.

emma: I'll keep oncall until we see no regressions for 30m. Filing incident ticket INC-4627 for postmortem.

emma: Planning handoff to mike at 05:00 UTC if stable - @mike please acknowledge.

mike: Ack. I'll take handoff at 05:00 and continue monitoring.

laura: Root cause (prelim): artifact-service registry auth token expired during a high burst -> new nodes couldn't pull images -> pods Pending -> autoscaler kept asking for nodes -> provider capacity errors and ENI rate limits compounded the problem. Lack of fallback registry and autoscaler backoff logic amplified duration.

raj: Action items:
- Immediate: add token-refresh alerting and automatic token rotate; add emergency fallback registry toggle.
- Short: update autoscaler to detect ImagePullBackOff and pause launch churn/backoff.
- Long: implement per-customer circuit breaker and configurable concurrency limits to protect shared pools.

nina: Coordinating customer-facing incident summary and credit offer.

emma: Closing initial pager. INC-4627 remains open for postmortem. Great job team :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Pager resolved: status GREEN. Summary: peak_queue=420, duration=39m, impacted_customers=[ACME Corp]. Link: https://redwood.incidents/INC-4627
